text: Procrastination is *mood repair.* You dodge the bad feeling, not the task.

label: FIX 1
head: Shrink the first step
sub: Not "write the report." Open the doc and write one ugly sentence.

label: FIX 2
head: Set a 10-minute timer
sub: You're allowed to quit when it rings. You almost never will.

label: FIX 3
head: Forgive yesterday's delay
sub: Students who forgave themselves for stalling procrastinated less on the next exam.
